entities.summary: Latozi Mpahleni, better known by her clan name Madosini, was a South African musician, singer, and cultural custodian. She was celebrated for her mastery of traditional Xhosa musical instruments such as the uhadi, umrhubhe, and isitolotolo. Madosini was regarded as a "national treasure" and a leading figure in the preservation of Xhosa indigenous music.
